name: Takamura Miyu
source:
Miyu is the protagonist's childhood friend.

Her family lost their company years ago after running into financial trouble, and she resents the Arihara family for it. At the start of the game, she's only interested in the protagonist's money.

[spoiler]The only person who pays her for sex is the protagonist.[/spoiler]
